settings.title: Turn-by-turn on the cluster and HUD
Wireless CarPlay (Bluetooth bridge and Wi-Fi sessions)
CarPlay music and Siri over Wi-Fi (AAC, Opus)
Song info on wireless CarPlay (cluster, media widget)
settings.description: DiPO only asks the iPhone for song info on USB; HMG-API asks on wireless too. A hook in DiPO (no files changed).

settings.title: Settings > Phone Projection opens Device Connections
settings.description: A hook in the Settings app (no files changed). US/Canada only; other regions keep the stock choice. Not in the Korean build (its hook point is missing on some Korean firmware).

settings.title: USB drives and hubs don't start wired Android Auto
settings.description: A hook in the Android Auto app (no files changed). Without it, a USB drive can block wireless Android Auto until the head unit restarts.

settings.title: Wireless Android Auto: resend ready after phone projection starts
settings.description: Korean build. A hook in the Android Auto app (no files changed): when the phone projection app starts after the phone's wireless setup, the ready signal it missed is sent again. Only while Korea Projection runs its hotspot.

settings.title: Android Auto cluster: keep the turn icon when the phone sends a road name change for the same point
settings.description: Korean build. When the phone alternates a turn and a road name change for the same point, the cluster keeps the turn icon and only the road name changes. Off: name changes show at once (as 2.4.0).
